pages.title: Thread and Edge
pages.text: Extend suitable equipment’s life through a distinct material repair method.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: In the Workshop, put Dragger Silk in slot 0 and eligible damaged equipment in slot 1. One silk restores 8–20 durability. Dragger spawning is denied, but the current Atlas contains the ordinary dragger_silk_recipe: use the effective recipe rather than enabling the mob.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: In the Workshop, put Dragger Silk in slot 0 and eligible damaged equipment in slot 1. One silk restores 8–20 durability. Dragger spawning is disabled in current rules: confirm another effective silk acquisition route rather than enabling the mob for a quest.
